description: This Perl script is a comprehensive package management utility used for handling package metadata, generating configuration files, dependencies, licenses, and SBOMs in a software project. It includes functions for parsing metadata, generating JSON representations, managing dependencies, and producing configuration snippets, indicating it is a substantial source file central to package management operations within the project.

methods.name: version_to_num
methods.description: Converts semantic version strings into numeric representations for comparison.

methods.name: version_filter_list
methods.description: Filters a list of versions based on a comparison against a target version.

methods.name: gen_kconfig_overrides
methods.description: Generates Kconfig override snippets based on package and build system configurations.

methods.name: __find_package_dep
methods.description: Recursively checks if a package depends on a specific package.

methods.name: find_package_dep
methods.description: Wrapper to prevent infinite recursion in dependency checks.

methods.name: package_depends
methods.description: Determines dependency relationships between two packages.

methods.name: mconf_depends
methods.description: Generates dependency configuration lines for package config files.

methods.name: mconf_conflicts
methods.description: Generates conflict dependency lines for package configs.

methods.name: print_package_config_category
methods.description: Outputs the configuration for a package category, including nested packages and dependencies.

methods.name: print_package_overrides
methods.description: Outputs package override configurations.

methods.name: gen_package_config
methods.description: Main function to generate package configuration snippets and category hierarchy.

methods.name: and_condition
methods.description: Combines multiple configuration conditions with logical AND.

methods.name: gen_condition
methods.description: Converts a complex logical condition into a string suitable for configuration logic.

methods.name: get_conditional_dep
methods.description: Wraps dependency strings with conditional logic based on other configurations.

methods.name: gen_package_mk
methods.description: Generates Makefile snippets for package dependencies and build rules.

methods.name: gen_package_source
methods.description: Outputs source file information for packages.

methods.name: gen_package_auxiliary
methods.description: Outputs auxiliary package variables like repository paths and dependencies.

methods.name: gen_package_license
methods.description: Prints license information for all packages or full list depending on level.

methods.name: gen_version_filtered_list
methods.description: Prints a filtered list of version strings.

methods.name: gen_usergroup_list
methods.description: Generates a list of user and group assignments for packages.

methods.name: parse_package_metadata
methods.description: Parses package metadata from files (assumed from code context).

methods.name: parse_package_manifest_metadata
methods.description: Parses package manifest files into metadata structures.

methods.name: parse_package_metadata
methods.description: Main function to parse package metadata from specified files.

methods.name: dump_cyclonedxsbom_json
methods.description: Builds and encodes CycloneDX SBOM JSON from component data.

methods.name: gen_image_cyclonedxsbom
methods.description: Generates SBOM for image packages in CycloneDX JSON format.

methods.name: gen_package_cyclonedxsbom
methods.description: Generates SBOM for packages in CycloneDX JSON format.

methods.name: parse_command
methods.description: Main command parser, dispatches functions based on CLI commands.
